scope.generator_models: all models referenced by normative execution stages
scope.automatic_judges: generator identity remains hidden from every automatic judge
scope.human_raters: generator identity remains hidden through all recognition, criterion and pairwise stages
scope.supplementary_models: excluded unless explicitly added before the protocol lock

alias_scheme.domain_separation: study ID and purpose are included in every HMAC message
alias_scheme.format: SYS- followed by at least 12 uppercase hexadecimal characters

commitment_scheme.mapping_commitment: keyed HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical model-to-alias map
commitment_scheme.reason: an unkeyed commitment would permit permutation enumeration for a small public model panel

key_custody.rotation: new independent key for each prospective study
key_custody.private_map_storage: restricted local or institutional secret-controlled storage

limitations: Software blinding does not create organisational independence when one person controls generation, key custody and analysis.
Operational use should separate the blinding custodian from primary rating and confirmatory analysis where feasible.
The committed repository contains policy and fixture evidence only, not an operational key or private mapping.
Fixture-verified study freezes do not establish independent custody or certify that a live dataset is complete.
